label: Shielded — rooted between him and the rows
location: The Verdant Ward, the nesting rows
injuries: Bark split along one arm where she took a blow meant for a sapling

recentEvents.value: Her thorns bend around the old alders and the walker calls it sorcery; the curves are the shape of her refusal to wound the Ward.

unresolvedConflicts.value: She protects the trees before herself, and he has learned to use it.

temporaryObjective.value: Hold the screen until the last nest is moved beyond the deep rows.
